text: The Pocket is a community in Toronto's East End bounded by Jones Avenue, the rail Tracks, Greenwood Avenue and the Danforth. Through the Pocket Community Association a neighbourhood project called "Pocket Change" was created some years ago to reduce its environmental footprint with the development of a neighborhood wide home retrofit project as well as other environmental interventions The Pocket already hosts one of the City’s oldest community gardens and was a neighbourhood leader in providing car share spots long before it became popular. There is one zero net emissions home and another sustainable home. It is a good neighbourhood to have such a project. The community undertook a successful tree planting project for the ROWs and have successfully worked on Vision Zero initiatives.
